result:
Everything is committed and verified. Final report follows.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/services/memory_admin.py` — new `update_memory_resource(workspace, memory_id, *, description, event_expiry_days)`: sends `UpdateMemory` with exactly `memoryId` plus the given fields, reads back with `GetMemory`, returns the `_detail` projection; docstring explains the `namespaceKeys` replace-wholesale trap and names the fallback (re-send `GetMemory().namespaceKeys`).
- `backend/app/routers/memory_resources.py` — `UpdateMemoryResourceRequest` (description 1–4096 optional, expiry 7–365 optional, at-least-one `model_validator`) and `PUT /{memory_id}` with no in-use or default guard; `_guard` now lets translatable `ClientError`s reach the global handler, so unknown ids are `404 aws.not_found`.
- `backend/app/core/route_policy.py` — `("PUT", "/api/memory/resources/{memory_id}")` as MEMBER.
- `backend/tests/test_memory_resources.py` — stub `update_memory` that mutates the readback; nine new update tests (exact kwarg sets, 6/366/empty/no-field 422s, not-found 404, default and in-use still editable, 502 mapping, response equals the GET detail).
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `MemoryResourceDetail`, `MemoryResourceUpdateInput`, `memoryResource()`, `memoryResourceUpdate()`; create now typed as returning the detail.
- `frontend/src/pages/memory/ResourcesTab.tsx` — shared `DescriptionField`/`ExpiryField` used by create and edit; EDIT per row opens an inline row pre-filled from the detail GET; SAVE with `disabledReason` (loading / nothing changed / invalid expiry / description cannot be cleared / saving); save `ConfirmDialog` naming referencing agents and the expiry impact; row refreshes from the PUT response.
- `frontend/src/locales/en/common.json`, `zh-CN/common.json` — 18 new `memoryPage.resources.*` keys each.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — `resources` row lists update + `UpdateMemory` (zh-CN table had no resources row at all; added it plus the separate-pair paragraph).
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — memory resources table with all five routes including the PUT (zh-CN had no memory section; added one).

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ Backend update tests: kwargs asserted as exact sets `{memoryId, description}`, `{memoryId, eventExpiryDuration}`, `{memoryId, description, eventExpiryDuration}` with explicit no-`namespaceKeys`/no-`memoryStrategies` checks; 6 and 366 → 422 with no AWS call; `{}` → 422; `ResourceNotFoundException` → 404 `aws.not_found`; response equals the GET detail and call order is `update_memory` then `get_memory`; the structural read-only test still passes.
- ✅ `tests/test_route_policy.py` and `tests/test_client_funnel.py` pass.
- ✅ Frontend: the probe confirmed EDIT pre-fills from the detail GET, SAVE disabled with "Nothing changed yet." then "Expiry must be a whole number of days between 7 and 365." on 6, the confirm dialog lists "hr-assistant, faq-bot" and the expiry impact, the PUT body was only `{"event_expiry_days": 14}`, and the row chip refreshed to UPDATING with no list reload. tsc, lint, and both i18n gates clean. Evidence in the SE-012 run dir: `ui_probe.out`, `confirm.png`, `after-save.png`.
- ✅ Docs: both architecture files list update + `UpdateMemory` in the `resources` row; both api files document the PUT.
- ✅ `make verify` PASS.
- ⚠️ Live AWS check: not exercised, per the brief. The host may update a dev memory holding one namespace key and confirm `GetMemory().namespaceKeys` is unchanged.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Expiry floor.** The offline botocore model gives `UpdateMemory.eventExpiryDuration` min 3, not 7 as the brief states. I implemented 7–365 as directed. Because validity is judged per changed field, a memory created with a 3-day expiry can still have its description edited.
- **Description cannot be cleared.** The model's description shape is 1–4096 chars, so an empty description is a 422 server-side and SAVE is disabled with a reason in the UI. The brief did not cover this case.
- **`_guard` not-found pass-through.** The brief asked for "the existing not-found mapping", but this router's guard turned every exception into a 502. I aligned it with the memory console router so mapped `ClientError`s reach the global 4xx handler. This also changes GET/DELETE behavior on unknown ids from 502 to 404.
- **zh-CN docs were behind.** Neither zh-CN doc had any resources or memory-resources content, so I added the missing row/section rather than only a mention.
- **No `clientToken` sent.** botocore fills the idempotency token itself; the kwargs assertions are exact sets without it.
